description: This file contains testing extensions for CanvasWindowController, providing internal test methods for session key sanitization, JavaScript string escaping, frame storage, IPv4 parsing, network checks, and URL classification. These methods are conditionally compiled for DEBUG builds.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: An extension of CanvasWindowController providing internal test functions for various functionalities.

methods.name: _testSanitizeSessionKey
methods.description: Returns a sanitized version of the session key for testing purposes.

methods.name: _testJSStringLiteral
methods.description: Returns a JavaScript string literal for the given string for testing purposes.

methods.name: _testJSOptionalStringLiteral
methods.description: Returns a JavaScript optional string literal for the given optional string for testing.

methods.name: _testStoredFrameKey
methods.description: Returns the stored frame defaults key for a given session key for testing.

methods.name: _testStoreAndLoadFrame
methods.description: Stores and then loads a frame for a session key, returning the loaded frame, used for testing.

methods.name: _testParseIPv4
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address string into four UInt8 components, returning nil if invalid.

methods.name: _testIsLocalNetworkIPv4
methods.description: Determines if an IPv4 address (represented as a tuple) is a local network address.

methods.name: _testIsLocalNetworkCanvasURL
methods.description: Checks if a given URL points to a local network address, utilizing an external handler.
